tests.description: abs and copysign only touch the sign bit, so they must preserve signed zero, infinities and the magnitude exactly.
acos and asin must agree with the platform on [-1, 1] and reject out-of-domain inputs.
atan2 must match the platform in every quadrant and follow IEEE for signed zeros on the axes.
atan must hit the known values exactly enough and stay within 4 ulp of the platform on both sides of the |x| = 1 reciprocal switch.
Reduction must flip above 1 and shrink u below tan(π/16) so the series converges.
exp must be within 2 ulp of the platform across its useful range.
The Taylor kernel must be exact at zero and accurate at the edges of its reduced interval.
The overflow and underflow thresholds and the split scale path just inside them must give inf, zero, and finite gradual-underflow values.
ln must be within 2 ulp of the platform and handle 0, negatives, infinity and subnormals.
next_down must step toward −∞ for positive, negative and zero inputs alike, since a raw bits−1 steps the wrong way for negatives.
The odd-denominator series must start at 1, follow the requested sign pattern, and converge to atan/atanh identities for small z.
Quadrant reduction must leave a remainder within about π/4 and pick the quadrant that sin_cos's sign table expects.
The 1-ulp correction steps down only when the lower neighbour's square is strictly closer, and otherwise leaves the guess alone.
The power-of-two scaler must stay exact past the normal exponent range by splitting the shift, which exp and the subnormal paths need.
sin and cos must stay within 2e-16 absolute of the platform across all four quadrants and moderately large angles.
The mantissa split must reconstruct x and keep m in [√½, √2].
sqrt must be within 1 ulp of the correctly rounded platform result across many magnitudes, and exact on perfect squares.
The Newton stage alone must already land within one ulp, so the correction only ever has a single neighbour to consider.
Subnormals take a scaled detour; NaN, negatives, zero and infinity are special-cased and must come back as IEEE prescribes.
tan is sin/cos, so it must agree with the platform away from poles.
trunc, floor and round are the building blocks of every range reduction; they must be exact, including negatives and halfway cases.
The unit complement is √(1−x²), exact at the ends and the middle.

tests.description: An ideal battery shorted by a wire is fatal: no solution, a named ShortCircuit with unlimited current.
Internal resistance makes the terminal voltage sag: 12 V with 1 Ω inside into 5 Ω gives 2 A and 10 V at the terminals.
A nonsensical value is reported, fatally, before anything is solved.
at wraps around the loop and reports whether a point is on a wire.
An empty loop has no length and returns the origin off-wire.
The lever swings about its pivot, and the knob sits at its tip.
The loop is closed: each section starts where the previous one ends.
The loop is the three wires plus three hidden stretches, and its length is their sum.
Only particles on wires are drawn, every one of them on the loop.
wrap maps any value into the half-open period.
t outside the unit interval extrapolates, so overshooting easings work.
f64 blends linearly and lands on the exact end value at t = 1.
Quaternions blend by slerp, so halfway between 0 and 90 degrees is 45 degrees.
Vectors blend per component.
Back substitution solves the upper factor from the bottom up.
The length check passes on a match and reports both sizes otherwise.
The pivot search must look only at or below row k, compare magnitudes, and keep the earliest row on ties.
Elimination must zero the column below the pivot (storing the multipliers there) and update the trailing block.
Forward substitution permutes b and applies the unit-lower factor.
A factored matrix must be reusable for several right-hand sides.
The empty system has the empty solution.
A 1×1 system is plain division.
A zero in the leading position must be pivoted around rather than reported as singular.
Singular, non-square and wrongly sized systems must report the specific error variant, not panic.
A well-posed 3×3 system must solve to its known answer, and the result must reproduce b when multiplied back.
The largest magnitude must ignore sign and be 0 for empty/zero input.
Error messages must name the problem in plain words.
Every simulation, whatever its types, is stepped the same number of times with the clock's fixed dt.
advance_with calls the closure once per owed step with the fixed dt.
Across uneven frames (16, 17, 50, 3 ms) two simulations stay in lockstep and receive exactly the steps the banked time allows.
The blanket Steppable impl forwards tick to Simulation::step.
A blown bulb has smoky glass lit only by the decaying flash.
Charges at rest are dim blue-grey; flowing ones are amber, whichever way they flow.
A cold bulb has clear, mostly transparent glass, a dark filament and no halo.
More glow means brighter glass, filament and halo.
Out-of-range glow and flash are clamped.
lerp3 blends each channel and hits both ends.
A fully lit bulb has warm glass, a hot filament and a halo.
Dense constructors, row access, row swaps and mat-vec products.
The identity is the default and leaves points unchanged; element access follows column-major layout.
The inverse must undo a general transform and refuse singular input.
Composition applies the right operand first, and transpose swaps rows and columns.
The offset helper maps row-major positions and IndexMut writes there.
A column past the end must panic instead of reading the next row.
Perspective puts the near and far planes at clip depth −1 and +1 and shrinks distant points; look_at maps the eye to the origin and the target onto −Z, returning identity for degenerate input.
The rotation matrix must agree with rotating by the quaternion.
The row helper must dot the right column-major entries and include the translation column only in proportion to w.
Translation moves points but not directions; scale stretches both.
Primitives are centred on the origin with the size asked for.
Vertex and triangle counts follow from the primitive's resolution.
A tube needs two distinct points; duplicates are dropped and too few points give an empty mesh.
An empty mesh has a point box at the origin.
Every vertex normal is unit length and every index is in range.
Low resolutions are raised to the minimum that still makes a solid.
Every non-degenerate triangle is wound counter-clockwise seen from outside.
Every ring of a tube stays its radius away from the path it follows.
Blown bulbs are reported in component order; intact ones are not.
Each stamp turns the voltage across it into the right current, and an ideal battery's unknown is negated to read "out of +".
A conductance between two unknowns stamps the classic ±g pattern; against the reference it only touches the diagonal.
A current source adds into `a` and out of `b`, skipping the reference.
An explicit ground wins for its own island only; another island still falls back to its battery.
Every component with a nonsensical value is named, in order.
An island with no battery and no ground has no reference.
The unexpected-singular safety net names a node for a voltage pivot and a battery for a current pivot.
Power is V × I, and a floating component's is zero.
Without an explicit ground, an island measures from the − terminal of its first battery.
Only nodes with a component attached count as touched.
A voltage source puts ±1 in its row and column and the EMF on the right-hand side.
In series, only the most overloaded bulb blows; that opens the loop and saves the other one.
Placing a component on a node from elsewhere panics.
Ids are handed out in creation order.
replace_bulb restores a blown bulb to a fresh one of the same rating.
set_switch on anything else is a no-op.
set_switch sets a switch to exactly the requested state.
toggle_switch flips and reports the new state, or None for a non-switch.
A resistor has no brightness.
Ohm's law: 6 V across 3 Ω drives 2 A, and the battery delivers the 12 W the resistor absorbs.
An overloaded bulb blows, leaving the battery with an open circuit; the blown bulb is listed last.
Two real batteries with different EMFs in parallel: 1 A circulates, the stronger one discharging and the weaker one charging, at 9 V.
Two ideal batteries side by side contradict each other: fatal loop.
Parallel resistors: 3 Ω ‖ 6 Ω is 2 Ω, so a 6 V battery delivers 3 A.
An empty path gives the origin, and zero-length segments are skipped.
The length of a polyline is the sum of its segments.
Distances before the start or past the end clamp to the ends.
Walking a distance lands on the right segment at the right place.
Empty grows to a point, then to a box holding every point.
Expanding adds a margin on every side.
A ray starting inside the box hits at distance zero.
A ray aimed at a box enters it at the near face.
A ray that passes beside or points away from the box misses.
A transformed box bounds every transformed corner.
Axis-angle builds unit quaternions that rotate by the right-hand rule; a zero axis gives the identity.
Multiplication composes right-first and the conjugate undoes a rotation.
Negation flips every component and is the same rotation.
Normalize restores unit length and maps zero to the identity.
Rotating by a unit quaternion never changes a vector's length.
Slerp hits both ends, moves at constant angle, and takes the short arc even when given the negated target.
The weights sum to the lerp fallback near d = 1 and follow the sin-ratio formula otherwise; at θ = π/2 the midpoint weights are √½.

Calls on a bad handle fail cleanly, including the pointer and float exports.

The bypass shorts the battery: no solution, every result NaN, issue 2.
The camera exports work in degrees and clamp to the camera's limits.

A new circuit gets a non-zero handle, and handles are distinct.
set_value takes effect at the next solve: half the volts, a quarter the power.
Toggle reports the new state each time.
Closed at its rated 12 V the 24 Ω bulb draws 0.5 A and 6 W, full brightness.
An unknown component id is ERR_COMPONENT; the wrong kind is ERR_KIND.
An encoded frame is a valid command buffer that sets the requested viewport.
A freed handle is never reused, so it cannot alias a newer circuit.
Nodes and components are numbered from 0 in creation order.
Toggle reports the new switch state and volts, replace and seek reach the view.
The issue mapping agrees with IssueKind in site/js/simbiguity.js.
Issue messages arrive through sb_out, and a past-the-end index is ERR_INDEX.
Mesh exports describe every mesh, and an index past the end is an error.
A new view hands out a nonzero handle and reads back the state it was built with.
With the switch open the loop is broken: no current, a dark bulb, and the engine names the open circuit.
At 20 V the bulb blows and stays blown until replaced.
Picking at the pixel the switch base projects to hits the switch; a corner of the sky hits nothing.
Placing a part on a node that does not exist is ERR_NODE.
A buffer from sb_alloc is writable and can be freed; null frees are no-ops.
is_active is true inside a clip, false at its end and outside it.
A looping timeline wraps time, including negative times.
A non-looping or empty timeline leaves time alone.
Seeking is exact: progress is a pure function of time and clamps to the clip.
then places clips back to back and with starts a clip alongside another.
Zero-length clips jump from 0 to 1 at their start; negative durations become zero.
An empty track samples to None and has zero duration.
Before the first key the track holds it, after the last it holds that.
Keys added out of order are sorted, and a key at an existing time replaces it.
Between keys the segment uses the easing of the key it arrives at.
A linear tween is from at 0, halfway at the midpoint and to at the end.
Sampling clamps before the start and after the end.
with_ease shapes the progress.
A zero-length tween jumps to its end value at time 0.
An unbalanced bridge (one lower arm 200 Ω) drives a known current through the bridge, from the hand-solved node equations 4·Vl − 2·Vr = 10 and 7·Vr − 4·Vl = 20.
The macro-generated operators must act componentwise on both types.
Cross products follow the right-hand rule; perp_dot is its 2D z part.
The cross product is perpendicular to both inputs, as the plan's identity requires.
Dot, length, distance and lerp follow their textbook definitions.
Normalize gives unit vectors and refuses the zero vector.
Advance runs whole fixed steps of wall-clock time.
Overvoltage blows the bulb, which breaks the loop, shows the broken filament and flashes; replacing it restores the circuit.
A closed switch at rated voltage drives half an amp and moves the charges.
encode and commands return the same frame.
The default camera opens on a three-quarter view within its zoom limits.
The glow warms up through its spring instead of snapping to the brightness.
An open switch means no current, so the charges stand still and the bulb stays dark.
Particle speed is proportional to current, signed, and zero for no current.
The switch is under the pixel its base projects to; empty sky picks nothing.
Seeking is deterministic: the same inputs and time give the same frame.
Toggling reports the new state and swings the lever toward it.
Wire current through merged nodes is recovered from Kirchhoff's law.
In a loop of wires, the wire that closes the loop is not a tree edge.
Every node is visited once, each tree is rooted at its lowest node, and children point at their parent through the joining wire.
A battery's current counts as flowing out of its + terminal and into its − terminal; a resistor's flows out of a and into b.
A circuit with no wires leaves every current untouched.
The current a battery drives through a resistor also flows through the wires on its way, with the sign of each wire's a → b direction.
A loop made only of wires gets zero on its chord, as documented.
Wires contribute no inflow; they only appear in the adjacency, from both ends.
